label: MSA demographic detail report, spot level (DTL and GRPDTL)
_note: DTL (single proposal) and GRPDTL (group) share one grammar, so one profile covers both. Network appears in the centered page header and changes mid-document, so it is tracked per page. Demo column names come from the table header, not from the 'Reporting Demo(s)' metadata line, which was observed to disagree with the actual column count.
